subject: E-3270: upload stalls on Linux
body:
Hello support team. We run MeshMail 2.8.3 on Ubuntu 24.04.
Starting last week, the moment I start a sync a dialog reads
"E-3270: upload stalled at 0 bytes/s".

There was a power failure during a sync last week. The
progress bar has been stuck on the same file since then.

I've already tried restarting the machine, which changed
nothing.

Priya Nair - Halden Logistics. Appreciate any pointers.
